title: Teacher Paul Roja and first instruments at about eleven
summary: Paul Roja, a good reader, taught him; he was about eleven, a year on bass drum, six months on baritone, then trumpet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Did those fellas teach you anything when you started out?
Well yeah. The man that taught me was named Paul Roja. He was a very good reader.
Roja. Paul Roja. He was a nice musician.
And when you started fooling around with bass drum, how old were you?
Well I say, now I can't exactly remember, but I put it around eleven years old.
Uh huh. And then how long did you stay on that?

I stayed on bass drum say like about a year. And I picked up the baritone, carried it along about six months. And we was playing pretty regular, see. So the boys on trumpets figured I was pretty strong and they told me to take a trumpet there, a half out more. So I took the trumpet and I played it mighty good.
